ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Forming shadows in light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Precautions when using and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain School environment environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping Safe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain The National and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
